notes.title: Lost Frequencies update is now in Beta! - Reworked Sonar, new items and UI!
notes.notes: [p]Crew, we have a major update coming and we need your help to test it![/p][h1]The Lost Frequencies update is now LIVE in the permanent beta branch of Steam.[/h1][p]This update completely reworks the Sonar you get at the beginning of the game and makes it into an [b]active mechanic[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/3862f0808132e5cae0dd4c51ca75da1891578329.gif"][/img][/p][h2]How the new Sonar works[/h2][p]Previously the Sonar would "vibrate" when in proximity of randomly spawned events and encounters. It would do so passively by changing the amplitude of a wave that surrounded your ship, in a somewhat subtle way. This led to many players missing the Sonar mechanic entirely and the world feeling more empty than it was supposed to be.[/p][p]That's why we reworked it.[/p][p]Now, the Sonar will alert you when there's stuff that can be found around you. When the Sonar buzzes, you can enter Search mode. While in Search Mode, Signals will approach your Airship - you'll need to lock onto these signals by pressing LMB (or A on the Controller) at the right time. When you do so they'll be highlighted for you and you'll be able to explore them and find out what's down there.[/p][h3]Why the Rework[/h3][p]Once again, this update stems from your feedback.[/p][p]After the Character Creator, the second most common feedback was that the world felt a bit "empty" with not much to do while traveling or inbetween contracts.[/p][p]This update is the first step in addressing that.[/p][p]We tried to make the Sonar more meaningful by making it an active mechanic while also adding more interesting encounters and "sonar-exclusive" rewards you can find around the world.[/p][h2]New missions, a ton of new rewards[/h2][p]Lost Frequencies comes with 8 different missions you can find using the Sonar, including new wave-based encounters, timed deliveries and more.[/p][p]These new missions bring a ton of new potential rewards including 10 new Epic Videogames, 17 new Chroma Paints and [b]Recipes![/b][/p][p]That's right, Recipes are now a collectible item you can find around the world - no more guesswork or datamining![/p][p]The Sonar also brings its own upgrades that can be purchased in Shops around the world and that will make Search Mode more forgiving.[/p][p]We're also introducing a new enemy variant: The Gunblade Goblin. It's got guns, it's got blades, it's got gunblades![/p][h2]New world UI[/h2][p]With this update we're also introducing a much needed revamp of the world UI.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/355c877a9c3585fffb9a0143370e5e1e87764b37.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The new UI features a clear indication of the Mood of each pilot, their health status and aspirations. Plus, we're introducing a "Low Supplies" warning, a "Damaged Mech" warning, a counter for Activity Tokens and a Wages timer.[/p][p]Overall we tried to give you all the important informations you need while traveling around the Wastelands, while also improving the readability and usability of the UI. [/p][h1]How to access the Beta[/h1][p]You will find a Beta branch right here on Steam called "Permanent Beta".[/p][p]You can access the Beta branch by right clicking on NITRO GEN OMEGA > Properties > Betas and choosing it from the drop-down menu.[/p][p][b][u]The Beta comes with an important warning: BACK UP YOUR SAVEFILES.[/u][/b][/p][p]Loading an existing save file might make it incompatible with the regular version of the game. Handle with care.[/p][p]Your savefiles are located in %localappdata%\\Overdrive\\Saved\\SaveGames[/p][p]Also, starting with this version we're experimenting with a handy auto-backup feature for savefiles. Your savefiles should be automatically backed up the first time you launch the beta. We might experiment in the future with allowing you to restore backup directly from the game. In the meantime, be safe out there and do your own backup![/p][h2]What needs testing[/h2][p]With this update we're also laying the foundation for more quests to come in the future - technically the first step is all the sonar missions we added. We did a lot of work under the hood to ensure forward compatibility of your savefiles but we might have missed an edge case somewhere.[/p][p]Additionally we reworked some things under the hood of the battle system.[/p][p]We're particularly interested in:[/p][list][*][p]Load your savefiles and let us know if everything is in order. Are your quests all in progress?[/p][/*][*][p]Are you noticing any changes in the battles? Any orders not working?[/p][/*][*][p]Are you enjoying the Sonar? :)[/p][/*][/list][p]Please let us know your thoughts here on the Steam forums or on Discord. We have a pretty nice community going on there so check it out!  [url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][p]More cool stuff to come soon. We've been sharing the latest on our development streams on [url="https://twitch.tv/destinybit"]Twitch[/url].[/p][p]Lock onto those signals![/p][p]GP[/p]

notes.title: Character Creator v2 is live! Recruit your custom characters!
notes.notes: [p]Crew,[/p][p]version 2 of the Character Creator Update is now LIVE! Alongside a hefty amount of new Upper Body combinations we introduced the possibility of recruiting Custom Characters in your games![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/2f2ee37c2f87eefdc4ce342596d0e039d9680ff6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now when you start a new game you will see a "Game Settings" button. For now the only setting available is "Created Pilot in Cities" which can be set as "Random" (custom pilots appear in cities alongside procedural ones) "Fill" (custom pilots will appear first before resorting to procedural characters, allowing you to create your own "mini universes") and "Disabled" (no custom character will ever appear in cities).[/p][p]You'll be pleased to know that this setting can also be changed mid-game from the pause menu and this means that all your existing savefiles are indeed compatible with this patch.[/p][p]This also opens up to possibly more game settings in the future (e.g. custom difficulty settings).[/p][p]Additionally, you can also decide on a character-by-character basis if a custom pilot is recruitable or not.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/58f9b9b743f8ab23f255dfc62bf5aa325b280455.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Bear in mind that each custom character (as defined by their ID) is unique for each savefile, therefore if that character dies it will be gone for good and won't show up again as a recruitable character in the future.[/p][p]We're excited to see where you will take this new feature![/p][p]In essence the "Fill" option allows you to create your mini-universes. If you create enough characters you could feasibly only see and recruit your creations (though you might eventually run out).[/p][h2]Here's more stuff included in this update[/h2][list][*][p]Added 27 new Upper Body Jacket/Shirt Combinations for Female Characters[/p][/*][*][p]Added 44 new Upper Body Jacket/Shirt Combinations for Male Characters[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the XP required to unlock skills, especially at higher levels[/p][/*][*][p]FIxed the Phoenix Cross General Store offerings and slightlly increased the chances of some ingredients and parts appearing in the Resonant Accord area.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Our next major update[/h2][p]We're hard at work on a Sonar rework that we hope to release in beta very soon! Here's a little sneak preview:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/3862f0808132e5cae0dd4c51ca75da1891578329.gif"][/img][/p][p]As you can see not only the Sonar has completely changed its behavior but we also overhauled the Overworld UI![/p][h2]Other things we're working on[/h2][p]Here's a non exhaustive list of things we're working on.[/p][list][*][p]A new mech[/p][/*][*][p]Two new enemies with variants.[/p][/*][*][p]New variants for existing enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]New activities & more.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous".[/h3][p align="start"]We share regular updates with our community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX"]Discord[/url] and our [url="https://www.twitch.tv/destinybit"]weekly stream[/url]. [/p][p align="start"]Be sure to join us on on Discord to interact with the development team and be up to date with everything-NGO.[/p][p align="start"][url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX" style="button"]Join the Discord![/url][/p][p align="start"]Thanks folks![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Character Creator v1 Update is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p]Crew,[/p][p]our most requested feature is now live in the game. The Character Creator v1 is now LIVE![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/0912b30a08c77673d180b9f9e76bf7a3ad707c32.png"][/img][/p][p]Last week we released the Character Creator in beta and your response has been truly heartwarming.
We're happy to see that our efforts are resonating with you and we hope you can see that we're truly doing our best in crafting NITRO GEN OMEGA.[/p][p][b]Today we're releasing it into the wild and to celebrate we're running a weeklong discount of 20% off on the game. Tell your friends![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/e4f053455d883cfd8cd09a58a7e7b7f68b2a388a.jpg"][/img]As we explained when we first announced it, the game was not meant to have a Character Creator. Our vision was for you to get attached to a random cast of character as if you just turned on the TV on a new anime show.[/p][p]But you kept asking for it, so who are we to say no?[/p][p]The game was built with procedural generation in mind, not to mention supporting hand-crafted 2d-looking animations so there's all sorts of hidden connections and limitations we built in for Generated Characters that we turned off for Created Characters.[/p][p]This means we gave you as much freedom as we technically could when it comes to creating your own characters but some limitations might still apply here and there.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/467f8386119303ccd4389eaccb83259dd3977789.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/da8ae16da1f2cd9609e9a271a60c2aa035f4ab52.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/36abf167ca60512c252e66975237fad805824808.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h1]Contents of the update[/h1][list][*][p]You can now access the Character Creator directly from the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]You can create and customize your characters, including their appearance, palette, name, last name, birthday, attitude, portrait pose and more![/p][/*][*][p]On a new game you can replace any of the four starting characters with a created character.[/p][/*][*][p]Some new hair and clothing have been added too.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Coming in v2[/h2][list][*][p]Full localization for the Character Creator. We preferred to roll it out now after the Beta and localize later. Should be coming soon.[/p][/*][*][p]We plan to add more combinations of hair and upper bodies using the ones we already have (i.e. mixing jackets and shirts that are potentially compatible but not available yet).[/p][/*][*][p][u]We're working on allowing created characters to appear in Fool's Inn around the world and become recruitable.[/u][/p][/*][/list][p]We're also exploring ways to let you share your creations with other players. Technically you can already do so as every Created Character is just a file you can share. You will find your creations alongside your savefiies.[/p][p]Your savefiles are located in %localappdata%\\Overdrive\\Saved\\SaveGames - you will find your Custom Characters in the "Saved" folder. Every Character is contained in its own folder.[/p][h3][u]FAQ: Does this mean Procedurally Generated Characters are gone?[/u][/h3][p]Not at all! Procedural Characters live alongside your creations and when you start a new game you can replace any of the four starting characters with Created ones. The generator is still there and working. When v2 goes live you will be able to choose how created characters will appear around the world in Fool's Inns alongside generated ones.[/p][h2]Other things we're working on[/h2][p]Here's a non exhaustive list of things we're working on.[/p][list][*][p]A new mech![/p][/*][*][p]Two new enemies with variants.[/p][/*][*][p]New variants for existing enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]A Sonar rework.[/p][/*][*][p]New activities & more.[/p][/*][/list][p]We share regular updates with our community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX"]Discord[/url] and our [url="https://www.twitch.tv/destinybit"]weekly stream[/url]. [/p][p][/p][h3]Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous".[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We'd like to thank the lovely people on our Discord who gave us feedback on the Character Creator as we were developing it.[/p][p align="start"]We hope you will like this update. We gave it our best to give you what you asked within the limits allowed us by the existing foundations of the game.[/p][p align="start"]Be sure to join us on on Discord to interact with the development team and be up to date with everything-NGO.[/p][p align="start"][url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX" style="button" buttoncolor="#ab12e2"]Join the Discord![/url][/p][p align="start"]Thanks folks![/p]

notes.title: NGO Character Creator is now in Beta!
notes.notes:
[p]We heard you.[/p][p]Since we've released the game in Early Access, arguably the number one most requested feature was a Character Creator.[/p][p]This is not what we initially envisioned for the game. We wanted you to get attached to your randomly generated crew, like getting attached to the protagonists of a show you just started watching. You didn't choose them, you grew fond of them.[/p][p]But still, you kept asking for it. So who are we to say no?[/p][p]Introducing, the [b]Character Creator[/b] - now in Beta![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/e4f053455d883cfd8cd09a58a7e7b7f68b2a388a.jpg"][/img]During development we spent a lot of time developing a Character Generator that could yield [i]believable[/i] anime characters. That took a lot of hand-tweaking, experimentation and lots of rules.[/p][p]We ripped them all out.[/p][p]Well, almost all of them.[/p][p]We've done everything we could to allow you the maximum amount of freedom possible without outputting straight up broken characters. This means that some limitations are still there but generally speaking you should feel a lot of freedom in the characters you can create.[/p][p]We gave a bit of an early access to it to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX"]Discord[/url] members and they seem to be enjoying it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/36abf167ca60512c252e66975237fad805824808.jpg"][/img]You can Customize the First and Last Name, date of birth, blood type and attitude. Change all the clothing and appearance and customize the character's palette.[/p][p]We're introducing Nicknames that we will also extend to existing characters and in the future we plan to let you also choose the Character's Avatar pose.[/p][p]When starting a new game you can replace any of your 4 starting pilots with a custom created one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/467f8386119303ccd4389eaccb83259dd3977789.jpg"][/img]Right now we're working on giving you the possibility of also finding Custom Characters in Fool's Inns around the world, allowing you to create an entire roster of characters for your own mecha anime.[/p][p]We're also exploring ways to allow you to easily upload and share your custom creations with other players. As of right now every Custom Character is a file that you can manually share.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/da8ae16da1f2cd9609e9a271a60c2aa035f4ab52.png"][/img]We hope you will like this update. We gave it our best to give you what you asked within the limits allowed us by the existing foundations of the game.[/p][p]We're releasing the update in Beta first, to gather feedback and see how you feel about it. We hope to release it as a full update in the very near future.[/p][h1]How to access the Beta[/h1][p]You will find a brand new Beta branch right here on Steam called "Permanent Beta". In the future we plan to push important updates there first.[/p][p]You can access the Beta branch by right clicking on NITRO GEN OMEGA > Properties > Betas and choosing it from the drop-down menu.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]The Beta comes with an important warning: BACK UP YOUR SAVEFILES.[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]Loading an existing save file might make it incompatible with the regular version of the game. Handle with care.[/p][p]Your savefiles are located in %localappdata%\\Overdrive\\Saved\\SaveGames - you will find your Custom Characters in the "Saved" folder.[/p][p][/p][p]Please let us know your thoughts here on the Steam forums or on Discord. We have a pretty nice community going on there so check it out!

[url="https://discord.com/invite/QppkZ6nNeX" style="button" buttoncolor="#b545d3"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][p]More cool stuff to come soon. We've been sharing the latest on our development streams on [url="https://twitch.tv/destinybit"]Twitch[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Show us your creations![/p][p]GP[/p]

notes.title: World Map & Skill Picking - Patch 03 is out!
notes.notes:
[p]Crew,[/p][p]Patch 03 is finally out and we're bringing you a couple of highly requested features: a World Map and the possibility of picking which Skill gets replaced when a pilot has reached their limit and they level up.[/p][p]We're working on some juicy stuff, but in the meantime I hope you'll enjoy this patch![/p][h1]
What's new[/h1][h3][b]Added a full-fledged in-game map to the game. Here's how it works:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can open the map by pressing M on the keyboard or X/Square on your controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Outposts and Capitals are now by default not shown in the minimap and map.[/p][/*][*][p]When a Location is first visited it will appear on the minimap and map.[/p][/*][*][p]When a Quest or Aspiration asks you to go to a specific Location, the location will still be marked on your map even if not discovered.[/p][/*][*][p]The map also groups the Outposts by faction.[/p][/*][*][p]The map shows the most important stores inside each location.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Added the possibility of picking which Skill to replace when you level up. Here's how it works:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Revamped the "New Skill Unlocked" screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Now when you unlock a new Skill with a Fool that has already reached maximum capacity, you will be prompted to choose a skill to replace or you can also discard the new randomly selected skill.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other fixes and improvements:[/h2][list][*][p]Added new Character Palettes![/p][/*][*][p]Added a new portrait pose for the "Guy with Glasses" personality.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Thrill of the Hunt" skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the position of the Greenhouse in Phoenix Cross.[/p][/*][*][p]All percentage-based skills now apply their bonus to the full value and not just the base value.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills that increase "All Damage" now also increase "Special Damage".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Cooking Recipes that were impossible to cook.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Bullet ammunitions from Monki parts that provided the Flamethrower order.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the magazine "Yep. It's Camporella".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a wrong texture on some shoes.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements and tweaks to some animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements and fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other notes[/h3][list][*][p]With the introduciton of the Map we've moved the hotkeys around on PC. Now you go back to your Airship with H, you open the Management Screen with O and you open the map with M.[/p][/*][*][p]We introduced some new strings into the game which aren't translated, we're aware and we're looking to rectify this soon![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Special shoutouts to The Grand Mugwump for the makeshift map that has carried the community until now. You're the Real MVP.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous". This will always be true from now on.[/h3][p][/p][p]We'd like to thank the lovely people on our Discord who gave us feedback on the World Map as we were developing it.

Be sure to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/QppkZ6nNeX"]Discord[/url][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FQppkZ6nNeX&snr=1_2108_9__2107"] [/url]to interact with the development team and be up to date with everything-NGO.

Thanks![/p]

notes.title: Stomp the bugs! - Patch 02 is OUT!
notes.notes:
[p]Crew,[/p][p]today we come to you with a smaller patch focusing on addressing several bugs discovered by our community. We have another patch coming (hopefully this week) with more quality of life features, including a map![/p][p][/p][h1]Here's a complete list of fixes:[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed Countermeasures not intercepting missiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Extinguish Fire not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Pilots would get an aspiration to complete contracts for Anchorage even though Anchorage has no Fixer. Pilots that had this aspiration will see it removed (with no consequences to mood).[/p][/*][*][p]Temporarely removed the "Power Grid Management" skill from the Skill Pools as we investigate an issue with it (pilots that already have it will keep it but just know that the bonus is applied in the mech building but is not taken into account when checking if the mech is ready for combat - i.e. the bonus isn't being applied correctly).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Gardening sometimes not providing any crops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where orders in the timeline would display targets even when not present (or show a target zone AND entity).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where targets would not appear in the Resolution Phase timeline.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit where it was possible to obtain infinite supplies from the Gas Station (you're all going to jail).[/p][/*][*][p]Temporarely removed the "Spin Left" and "Spin Right" orders from the Prometheans as we investigate issues with them. They were making the Monkinators unfairly powerful and this should put an end to that.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where eyelashes color was showing up as lipstick color. This means that some of you might see characters lose their lipstick or see the lipstick change color.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the "Full Stash" achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some inconsistencies in order priorities.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the frequency of Random Map Events (we're currently investigating why some of you have the feeling that they're not spawining at all - it's probably a mix of frequency, location and feel of the radar).[/p][/*][/list][h3]

Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous". This will always be true from now on.[/h3][p][/p][p]We hope you'll enjoy our efforts in quickly patching out the issues we find. Stay tuned for another upcoming patch focusing on quality of life and new smaller features.

Be sure to join us on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FQppkZ6nNeX&snr=2___"]Discord [/url]to interact with the development team and be up to date with everything-NGO.

Thanks![/p]

notes.title: Lock your characters - Patch 01 is OUT!
notes.notes:
[p]Crew, we're listening!

We come to you with the very first patch for the Early Access of NITRO GEN OMEGA which should bring some really sought after features and fixes.

Thank you for the warm reception of our little big game NITRO GEN OMEGA! We are going through all feedback you left us our [url="https://discord.gg/QppkZ6nNeX"]Discord[/url] server, in livestreams' chats, forums and in the in-game form you can access just before exiting.

Here's a list of everything that is new:[/p][list][*][p][b]When creating a new game, you can now lock characters you like in the character generation screen!

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/8943b5e21e005ee739388eda2401a0205c973f9f.png"][/img]
When you start a new game you can now lock characters before rerolling their appearance in order to keep the ones you like the most. This feature works when you create a game. Pilots that are available in cities cannot be rerolled, but you can visit the city after a while or move to another one to find one that vibes more with your Crew.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes
[/b]This include fixes to the Breakdown theme in battle, Engineering Skills appearing on the Driver and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balancing Fixes
[/b]Your pilots should be unlocking skills slightly faster now as well as other smaller changes here and there.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization Fixes[/b]
Added some missing translations on most languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Should you encounter any issue with this version, the previous version of the game is available in a beta branch called "previous". This will always be true from now on.[/h3][p][/p][p]That's it! We hope you'll enjoy these changes. We're listening to your feedback and taking notes and addressing the most pressing issues. So far we've been very happy with the response and we're very grateful for all your feedback!

Be sure to join us on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FQppkZ6nNeX"]Discord [/url]to interact with the development team and be up to date with everything-NGO.

Thanks!

[/p]

notes.title: NITRO GEN OMEGA is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[p]Crew, it's time to fire up your engines.[/p][h1][b]NITRO GEN OMEGA is OUT NOW in Steam Early Access![/b][/h1][p]And we have a brand new anime-infused launch trailer to celebrate:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sg9jsg3cPS4;full"][/previewyoutube][h1][b]Here's what you can find in the Early Access[/b][/h1][list][*][p]A whole continent for you to explore! Meet the various factions that inhabit the wastelands, visit 16 different cities and outposts and unlock upgrades for your airship![/p][/*][*][p]Two mechs: the mighty Monki, powerful and well-rounded and the Ocelot: a powerful gunslinger.[/p][/*][*][p]Over 150 mech parts to collect, as well as paint buckets to customize your mean machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect magazines and videogames to improve the skills of your pilots. Grow vegetables and cook delicious recipes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/09ad0340d4280d8f5318539057c30b1ab6bd7c40.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]A deep, innovative timeline-based battle system[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Order your Gunner to shoot, your Driver to dodge, your Engineer to reload and your Operator to Scan. Enemies will try to deceive you - predict their moves and outmanouver them![/p][/*][*][p]An innovative, deep battle system where resource management, positioning and timing are the key to victory. Customize your Mech, unlock skills and find your strategy![/p][/*][*][p]Face many different types of enemies and variants. Engage in encounters against waves of enemies, protect the cargo and survival.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/2b66ac53cba9af0769e2cd3cdfc7898e7fce82dd.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Grow bonds aboard your airship[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Have your pilots engage in several activities to choose from, including Gardening and Cooking.[/p][/*][*][p]Develop bonds between your pilots and watch friendships blossoms and rivalries form.[/p][/*][*][p]Make your own story: your characters have aspirations and traits. Events will happen aboard the ship. Manage morale, relationships and develop your pilot's skills![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/75200a58e5d55420bb38fea2d996864001cafb0e.png"][/img][/p][p]We plan on involving the community in the development, and building game game with player feedback in mind, so join us here on Steam, on [url="https://discord.gg/6pe4Htwtw7"]Discord[/url] and on our socials (see below).[/p][p][/p][p][url="http://bit.ly/NGODiscord" style="button"]Join us on Discord![/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]And if you need an extra bit of motivation, we're running a launch discount at 10% off![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, if you wish to support us even further, we have a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55348/"]Supporter Bundle[/url] available which includes the amazing OST by composer Alex Moukala and the Official Artbook by LARIATO CORP full of concept art.

So.... that is it I guess. It's out.
What a ride. I've been here before - exhausted. Somewhat never happy. I gotta say though, we did our best with this one. Not sure what will happen, but we truly did. Let us know how we did. Join us on Discord. Talk to us. You'll find out we're... people. Making toys. We just want you to have fun.[/p][p]Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Crew,

Our Mech's engine is revving up. It's time!

[h2]NITRO GEN OMEGA is releasing into into Early Access on June 17th, 2025![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/ecf15f4e14c53969a7ec6cc8055317cdb9450372.png[/img]

That's right, spring actually ends on June 20th - *adjusts glasses* this has been our plan all along !

But in all seriousness. This has been an incredible journey full of ups and downs. We've been working relentlessly to incorporate as much of your feedback as possible from the demo into the Early Access launch. We look forward to share more about all the changes and the improvements we made with you in the coming days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/2e5cce06ecf0c10ac76446ed162f358526a0b937.png[/img]

[h1]A sandbox shonen open-world tactical RPG[/h1]
Humanity lost the war against the machines. The few that remains live on cities built atop of giant pillars. Recruit your team of Fools, assemble your Mech and start making a name for yourself.
Explore a large open-world featuring 16 different cities and outposts. Complete contracts and quests for the various factions that populate the continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/add2fab1596929073b1f1cfb5cf5d4c15a43114c.png[/img]

[h1]Innovative tactical gameplay[/h1]
Dive into an innovative timeline-based combat system that rewards accurate planning, prediction and intuition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/7c9d3933381e9c693c25263d844643f00506212e.jpg[/img]
Order your Driver to move, your Gunner to shoot, your Engineer to reload and your Operator to deploy smokes. Lay your plans on the timeline as if you were editing your own anime episode, then watch in in action during the Resolution Phase.

[h1]Tend to your Crew[/h1]
Your Airship is also your mobile base, where your team relaxes and trains between battles. Forge bonds, tend to morale, cook delicious recipes and grow plants in the greenhouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/75200a58e5d55420bb38fea2d996864001cafb0e.png[/img]
Unlock skills for your Pilots, build Relationships and watch them unfold in battle in the form of powerful Momentum Shifts.

[h1]A game that looks and feels like an anime[/h1]
Since the very beginning we wanted to make a game that felt like playing an anime. We poured a lot of love into every animation, color choice and design decision in the hopes of bringing to life our "spaghetti-anime" vision. A love letter to anime, that beats an italian heart. Featuring a wonderful dynamic soundtrack composed by Alex Moukala.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236986/9aafee7b2075ce87a7688ea980cdd4eec96de8d2.png[/img]

June 17th, 2025 is just around the corner and we can't wait to welcome you all to the world of NITRO GEN OMEGA. We hope this is just the beginning of our adventure together but for now we're very grateful to have you along for the ride.

Be sure to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/QppkZ6nNeX]Discord [/url]to interact with the development team and be up to date with everything-NGO.

We've done our best to bring to you a sandbox-shonen experience. We hope you will have fun playing it.

Gian Paolo Vernocchi
CEO & Creative Director

notes.title: Demo Patch 01 is out - no more blurriness!
notes.notes:
Crew,
thank you very much for all the feedback on the Demo thus far. We're taking notes of all the suggestions and issues that are popping up. In the meantime we wanted to get a quick patch out that addresses a couple of the most concerning issues. Full changelog below!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Addressed the blurriness at high resolution. Now it should scale better and is capped. We might look for a better solution/more customization for the final game but the blurriness is part of the ahestetic so we're gonna do our best to make it seem seamless.
[*] Resolution scale now is capped at 100 instead of 200.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Event screen would get stuck if a bar was already at 100% (or 0%).
[*] Minor fixes and improvements.
[*] Added a link to an optional feedback form when quitting the game.
[/list]

[i]For future reference: should we break anything (we're human afterall) - there's a public branch on Steam called "previous" which you can use to access the previous build that was live. 
[/i]

Thanks and feel free to let us know your thoughts on Discord (link below) or in the forum.
Cheers!

GP
